description: Minimal shared hub foundation that Module 11 needs to run and be tested end to end (OPTION A, scoped as tight as possible): config, constants, full DB schema copied verbatim from ARCHITECTURE, connection + idempotent migrate, minimal role/auth dependency, minimal FastAPI app, and an idempotent demo seed with dashboard-demo rows. Independent of FEAT-002's endpoint code but FEAT-002 depends on everything here. Does NOT implement People/Memories/Medications/Schedule/Assistant/Games/Trivia/Backup/Auth routers.
steps: Add `pytest` to backend/requirements.txt, keeping existing entries (fastapi, uvicorn[standard], faster-whisper, httpx, python-multipart, python-dotenv). Create a venv and install: `cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt`. If faster-whisper fails to install in the sandbox, instead run `pip install fastapi uvicorn httpx python-multipart python-dotenv pytest` and record that in findings — nothing in Module 11 imports faster-whisper.

Fill backend/app/config.py: call python-dotenv load_dotenv() (tolerate a missing .env), then read DB_PATH, PHOTO_DIR, OLLAMA_URL, LLM_MODEL, WHISPER_MODEL from os.environ with the exact defaults from backend/.env.example (storage/echovault.db, storage/photos, http://localhost:11434, qwen2.5:3b, small). Expose as module-level constants.

Fill backend/app/constants.py with values matching the schema CHECK constraints EXACTLY: CATEGORIES=('identity','routine','history','preference','care_safety','engagement'); IMPORTANCE=('critical','important','general'); TRUST=('verified','unverified','conflicting','outdated'); VALIDITY=('persistent','scheduled','temporary','archived'); MEDICATION_STATUSES=('unconfirmed','taken','skipped'); ROLES=('patient','caregiver'); ACCESS_LEVELS=('admin','editor','viewer'); LANGUAGES=('fil','en','fil-en'); ALLOWED_GAME_TOPICS=['family_names','relationships','routines','familiar_places','recent_events'] (seed values plus game/trivia vocab implied by ARCHITECTURE sections 8-9 and PRODUCT features 6-7; add a comment that this is a FIXED set and unknown topics are rejected); SETTINGS_DEFAULTS={'game_topics':['family_names','relationships','routines'],'game_difficulty':1,'trivia_frequency_min':120,'quiet_hours':{'start':'21:00','end':'07:00'}}.

Fill backend/app/database/schema.sql by copying the ENTIRE SQL block from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 'Database Schema' section verbatim: leading `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;`, all 14 tables (patient, caregivers, settings, people, places, memories, schedule_items, schedule_acks, medications, medication_times, medication_logs, trivia_questions, activity_log, assistant_log), the idx_* indexes, the memories_fts virtual table, and the mem_ai/mem_ad/mem_au triggers. Copy the whole thing even though SET only touches some tables — a partial schema causes foreign-key failures.

Fill backend/app/database/connection.py: `connect(db_path)` doing sqlite3.connect, row_factory=sqlite3.Row, and `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON` on EVERY connection; a `get_db` FastAPI dependency that yields a connection using config.DB_PATH (create parent dir if missing) and closes it; `migrate(conn)` that reads schema.sql and runs it with executescript, idempotent (schema uses IF NOT EXISTS, so a second run must not error or lose data).

Fill backend/app/middleware/dependencies.py: `get_role` reads X-Role and X-Caregiver-Id headers, returning a small dict/struct; reject missing or unknown X-Role with HTTP 403. `require_caregiver` dependency: 403 for patient role; for caregiver role, look up caregivers WHERE id=:X-Caregiver-Id AND is_active=1 (via get_db) and 403 if absent/inactive; otherwise allow and expose the caregiver id. Build ONLY what SET needs — no admin/editor/viewer access-level logic.

Fill backend/app/main.py minimally: create the FastAPI app, run migrate() on startup against config.DB_PATH, and register the settings and dashboard routers (import them even though FEAT-002 fills their bodies — leaving router objects importable now keeps main.py stable). Keep it minimal: NO Ollama/Whisper/static-photo mounting, no heavy imports. If registering before FEAT-002 fills the routers is awkward, FEAT-002 will finalize registration; ensure the file at least imports cleanly.

Fill backend/app/database/seed.py with an idempotent `seed(conn)` creating MINIMAL demo data using FIXED ids and INSERT OR IGNORE / existence checks so re-running adds no duplicate rows: one patient (id=1, full_name set, language 'fil-en'); at least one caregiver with is_active=1 and a REAL salted hash in pin_hash (use hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac on a demo PIN — never store plaintext; Auth module owns real login later); the four settings rows (game_topics, game_difficulty, trivia_frequency_min, quiet_hours) as JSON strings matching SETTINGS_DEFAULTS; and for the dashboard demo: at least one unverified memory with source='ai_suggested', one conflicting pair (two memories trust='conflicting' pointing at each other via conflicts_with), one outdated memory (trust='outdated') with a recent updated_at, one medication plus one unconfirmed medication_log with due_at in the past AND/or one skipped log, one assistant_log row with flagged=1, and a few activity_log rows across different activities and topics mixing played and skipped outcomes. Every photo_path must be NULL or point to a file that exists (use NULL).
acceptance_criteria: From backend/ with venv active, `python -c "from app import config; print(config.DB_PATH)"` prints storage/echovault.db with no .env present.
`python -c "from app import constants as c; assert c.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS['trivia_frequency_min']==120 and 'family_names' in c.ALLOWED_GAME_TOPICS; print('ok')"` prints ok.

`python -c "import sqlite3; from app.database import connection as cx; c=sqlite3.connect(':memory:'); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; cx.migrate(c); cx.migrate(c); n=len([r[0] for r in c.execute(\"select name from sqlite_master where type='table'\")]); assert n>=14; print('tables', n)"` lists >=14 tables and does not error on the second migrate.

`python -c "import sqlite3; from app.database import connection as cx; from app.database import seed; c=sqlite3.connect(':memory:'); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; cx.migrate(c); seed.seed(c); seed.seed(c); assert c.execute('select count(*) from patient').fetchone()[0]==1; print('ok')"` prints ok (seed idempotent, single patient).
`python -c "from app.main import app; print(type(app).__name__)"` prints FastAPI.
verification: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt (or the documented fallback install if faster-whisper fails)
Run each acceptance-criteria python -c snippet from backend/ with the venv active; all must print the expected output and exit 0.
Confirm the second migrate() and second seed() calls do not raise and do not create duplicate rows (patient count stays 1).
findings: FEAT-002 handoff: (1) Seeded ACTIVE caregiver id = 'caregiver-demo-1' (access_level 'admin', is_active 1). Use caregiver test headers X-Role: caregiver and X-Caregiver-Id: caregiver-demo-1. Patient reads use X-Role: patient (no caregiver id). (2) Demo PIN hashing: app/database/seed.py exposes hash_pin(pin) = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha256', pin, salt=b'echovault-demo-salt', iterations=100000).hex() (64-char hex). Demo PIN is '1234'. This is a seed-only convention; the real Auth module owns login and may change salting. (3) faster-whisper INSTALLED successfully (faster-whisper 1.2.1) — full `pip install -r requirements.txt` worked, no fallback needed. Nothing in Module 11 imports it. (4) venv activation (from backend/): `. .venv/bin/activate` (bash/zsh), i.e. `source backend/.venv/bin/activate`. (5) Both SET router stubs now expose an importable `router = APIRouter(...)` object (settings tagged 'settings', dashboard tagged 'dashboard') and are already registered in main.py via app.include_router; FEAT-002 should ADD route handlers onto those existing router objects rather than re-registering. (6) main.py runs connection.migrate() on FastAPI startup against config.DB_PATH (importing app.main does NOT create a DB; only TestClient/uvicorn startup does). (7) Dashboard demo rows present after seed: 1 ai_suggested+unverified memory, a conflicting pair (mem-conf-a/mem-conf-b linked via conflicts_with), 1 outdated memory (recent updated_at), medication 'med-1' with 1 unconfirmed log (due_at ~2h ago) + 1 skipped log, 1 flagged assistant_log row, 4 activity_log rows mixing completed/skipped/stopped across topics. (8) Convention reminders honored: no DTOs, Manila localtime via datetime('now','localtime'), single patient id=1, PRAGMA foreign_keys ON set on every connection in connection.connect(). Tests must use a temp/:memory: DB, never backend/storage/echovault.db.
